The available notes do not establish exactly when the footbridge reopened to the public or what caused the delay.

The repair report lists September 3 as the first public reopening, but an attached notice says the bridge remained closed until September 10. The notes do not explain whether these dates refer to different hours, different sections of the bridge, or a reopening that was later reversed. One walking-group member remembers crossing on September 5; another remembers finding the east entrance locked that evening. Both recollections may be accurate, but the material does not explain the difference.

The explanations for the delay also conflict. The contractor cites a missing inspection signature. The council says the signature was already on file and cites incomplete barrier removal. Neither summary includes the inspection sheet or the barrier removal log, so these notes do not establish which explanation is correct or who was responsible.
